Context: 10. Retention of Accommodation

Retention/ allotment of GPRA on re-appointment in an eligible Central Government Office or fresh appointment/ re-appointment in statutory I autonomous/ quasi-judicial bodies, etc.The officers re-employed by the ACC to continue in the same post after superannuation for the extended period shall be permitted to continue in the residential accommodation occupied by them till the end of the tenure and they will be further eligible for retention of the said accommodation as per the provisions of Rule 40 on
